description: The collaborating German and Vietnamese institutions publish changes in Da Nang’s building stock between October 2015 and August 2017. Satellite interpretation assigns buildings to nine types and changes to five categories. Results are aggregated to administrative wards and 250-metre hexagons, supplied as Shapefiles in UTM zone 49N with QGIS and ArcGIS styling files. The Zenodo deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Infrastructure simulation modellers can use the counts and changes to estimate evolving service demand or test urban-development assumptions. The released polygons describe aggregated areas, not individual building footprints, and interpretation error limits fine-scale conclusions. File contents were not downloaded or checked numerically. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Changes in the building stock of DaNang between 2015 and 2017
notes: G4-0429; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
provider: University of Tübingen, German Aerospace Center and Da Nang Institute for Socio-Economic Development
